historyProbe.source: harness/review/post-rework-probes.test.ts test 1, flatblock, fixed 732 visible rows

map:pool.reads.reason: Existing per-known-issue read cursor map; deferred cutoff rule 2 owns bounding it to resident issues.

map:pool.repo.issues.reason: Existing repo-to-known-issue bucket map adds one history-only repo bucket; deferred cutoff rule 2 owns known issue membership.

map:pool.seats.reason: Existing sorted seat mirror retains owner entries for known cold sessions; deferred cutoff rule 2 owns those owner indexes.

set:pool.repo.issues.bucket.reason: Existing repo issue buckets contain every known issue, including cold history; deferred cutoff rule 2 owns those memberships.

set:pool.worktree.sessions.bucket.reason: Existing worktree session buckets retain known cold sessions; deferred cutoff rule 2 owns those memberships.

set:pool.worktree.sessions.issueless.buc.reason: Existing issueless subset retains stopped unbound cold session ids; deferred cutoff rule 2 owns those memberships.

historyProbe.filingEligibility: Archived/deleted resident rows release their filing reaction. Proposed/shipping resident rows retain theirs because pending stage edits can make them show without a table publication.
historyProbe.coldReads: Zero synchronous cold reads at startup, paint, and after settling at both history sizes; the existing load window batches requested rows.
historyProbe.placementDependency: A cold agent parent with a live descendant is loaded in the existing batch window only while its declared flatUntil summary (existing own/member/lane keepers) can give pre-nesting presence. Parentless agent ancestors retain their started-by fallback, and cold starter/keeper sessions answer through their declared summary.
